newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: McDonalds' gaffe has Nazi map of Austria on mats.
newsitem.headline: McDonalds' gaffe has Nazi map of Austria on mats.

text.p: Fast food chain McDonalds Austria is in a pickle over its latest advertising gimmick which has placemats featuring a map of the country as devised by Nazi dictator Adolf Hitler.
McDonald's told Die Kurier daily that it had simply wanted to highlight the beef-producing regions of Austria on the paper mats which cover its trays.
Coincidentally, the mats' division of Austria into seven districts, instead of the current nine, exactly matches Hitler's plan for the Alpine nation which he annexed in 1938.
McDonald's Austria marketing director Barbara Enzinger called the blunder "an unfortunate coincidence".

Gerhard Martinek at German advertising agency Heyer & Partner which devised the campaign said it had been done by someone who did not know the Austrian borders and had joined some provinces together to simplify the design.
"We certainly don't want to provoke anyone with the theme of the Nazi era," Martinek said.
McDonald's Austria has said it will remove the mats from its 75,000 outlets immediately.
